# Tsunami native-context fixture

Derived from SparkFun Electronics' [Tsunami Qwiic schematic](https://github.com/sparkfun/SparkFun_Tsunami_Super_WAV_Trigger_Qwiic/blob/336eb78afcebdcea91bf6caa554670940aae7bd5/Hardware/SparkFun_Tsunami_Qwiic.sch), distributed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Original [license notice](https://github.com/sparkfun/SparkFun_Tsunami_Super_WAV_Trigger_Qwiic/blob/336eb78afcebdcea91bf6caa554670940aae7bd5/LICENSE.md).

The derivative contains native component and connectivity evidence for two sheets. `source.json` binds the source and derivative hashes. It is a CPU boundary fixture, not a model transcript or a claim that a model can interpret the complete schematic. The measured text-token count excludes chat, tools, and image tokens; a stub processor uses that fixed lower bound to test explicit context rejection without loading model weights in CI.
